## Objectives {#objectives}

By the end of this session you can:

- Reconstruct the semester's pipeline map from memory.
- Name which checks caught real errors, and where.
- Carry your `checks.R` forward into your own research.
- State your own AI-use policy.

## What we cover {#coverage}

- The thirteen investigations, replayed as one arc.
- The verification ledger: which checks caught what, all semester.
- The `checks.R` showcase.
- The reveal: how this course was built — AI-assisted, and disclosed,

**Verification habit.** All of them — the verifier's posture is the
job now.
